name: Kodomo no Asobi
source:
The protagonist in Kodomo no Asobi has been suffering from a weak constitution ever since childhood. The cause of this is a strange curse that was placed upon him. Then when a new spring arrives he is just about ready to accept his fate of living with it for the rest of his life, unable to see a way out of this. It’s at that time that he meet “that person”. Even though she seems to know about him, he doesn’t remember meeting her before.

She tells him that even after so many years, the feelings inside of her haven’t changed at all. She still loves him so much that she can no longer bear it. However, she says all of this with a disappointed look on her face. What’s going on here?

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/kodomo-no-asobi/]Otaku Lair[/url]]
translation:
《孩童游戏》的主人公从小体弱多病，原因是身上被施加了奇怪的诅咒。新的一年到来时，他已经准备接受命运，带着诅咒度过余生，因为看不到摆脱它的方法。就在这时，他遇见了“那个人”。她似乎认识他，可他却不记得曾经见过她。

她告诉他，经过这么多年，自己心中的感情一点也没有改变。她依然深爱着他，已经无法忍受这份感情。然而，她说这些话时，脸上却带着失望的表情。到底发生了什么？

[摘自[url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/kodomo-no-asobi/]Otaku Lair[/url]]
